units.source_text: 由于久米的体贴，名人不下将棋而搓麻将，对手是久米、岩本六段和砂田记者。

en.t: Thanks to Kume's thoughtfulness, the Master did not play shogi but played mahjong; his opponents were Kume, Iwamoto sixth dan, and the reporter Sunada.

units.source_text: 这三人都谨小慎微，名人却专心致志，独自沉思。

en.t: All three of them were cautious and meticulous, but the Master was wholly absorbed, thinking deeply by himself.
